verses.original: יוֹסֵ֖ף וַיִּפֹּ֥ל עַל־ אָבִ֑יו פְּנֵ֣י וַיֵּ֥בְךְּ עָלָ֖יו וַיִּשַּׁק־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ way·yip·pōl ‘al- ’ā·ḇîw pə·nê way·yê·ḇək ‘ā·lāw way·yiš·šaq- lōw
verses.literal: Then Joseph fell upon his father’s face wept over him and kissed him

verses.original: יוֹסֵ֤ף אֶת־ וַיְצַ֨ו הָרֹ֣פְאִ֔ים עֲבָדָיו֙ אֶת־ לַחֲנֹ֖ט אֶת־ אָבִ֑יו יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ הָרֹפְאִ֖ים אֶת־ וַיַּחַנְט֥וּ
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- way·ṣaw hā·rō·p̄ə·’îm ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ’eṯ- la·ḥă·nōṭ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇîw yiś·rā·’êl hā·rō·p̄ə·’îm ’eṯ- way·ya·ḥan·ṭū
verses.literal: And Joseph - directed the physicians in his service - to embalm - his father Israel So they - embalmed him

verses.original: אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וַיִּמְלְאוּ־ לוֹ֙ כִּ֛י כֵּ֥ן יִמְלְא֖וּ יְמֵ֣י הַחֲנֻטִ֑ים מִצְרַ֖יִם וַיִּבְכּ֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ שִׁבְעִ֥ים יֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm way·yim·lə·’ū- lōw kî kên yim·lə·’ū yə·mê ha·ḥă·nu·ṭîm miṣ·ra·yim way·yiḇ·kū ’ō·ṯōw šiḇ·‘îm yō·wm
verses.literal: taking the forty days required to complete - - . . . the embalming And the Egyptians mourned - for him seventy days

verses.original: יְמֵ֣י בְכִית֔וֹ וַיַּֽעַבְרוּ֙ יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר בֵּ֥ית אִם־ מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּעֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם נָ֨א דַּבְּרוּ־ נָ֕א בְּאָזְנֵ֥י פַרְעֹ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: yə·mê ḇə·ḵî·ṯōw way·ya·‘aḇ·rū yō·w·sêp̄ way·ḏab·bêr ’el- par·‘ōh lê·mōr bêṯ ’im- mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·nê·ḵem nā dab·bə·rū- nā bə·’ā·zə·nê p̄ar·‘ōh lê·mōr
verses.literal: When the days of mourning had passed Joseph said to Pharaoh’s . . . court If I have found favor in your eyes please tell . . . . . . Pharaoh that . . .

verses.original: אָבִ֞י הִשְׁבִּיעַ֣נִי לֵאמֹ֗ר הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִי֮ מֵת֒ תִּקְבְּרֵ֑נִי שָׁ֖מָּה בְּקִבְרִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּרִ֤יתִי לִי֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן וְעַתָּ֗ה אֶֽעֱלֶה־ נָּ֛א וְאֶקְבְּרָ֥ה אֶת־ אָבִ֖י וְאָשֽׁוּבָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇî hiš·bî·‘a·nî lê·mōr hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî mêṯ tiq·bə·rê·nî šām·māh bə·qiḇ·rî ’ă·šer kā·rî·ṯî lî bə·’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an wə·‘at·tāh ’e·‘ĕ·leh- nā wə·’eq·bə·rāh ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî wə·’ā·šū·ḇāh
verses.literal: my father made me swear an oath when he said . . . I am about to die You must bury me . . . in the tomb that I dug for myself in the land of Canaan Now let me go . . . and bury - my father and then return

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֑ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר עֲלֵ֛ה וּקְבֹ֥ר אֶת־ אָבִ֖יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁבִּיעֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh way·yō·mer ‘ă·lêh ū·qə·ḇōr ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ka·’ă·šer hiš·bî·‘e·ḵā
verses.literal: Pharaoh replied Go up and bury - your father as he made you swear [to do]

verses.original: יוֹסֵ֖ף וַיַּ֥עַל לִקְבֹּ֣ר אֶת־ אָבִ֑יו כָּל־ עַבְדֵ֤י פַרְעֹה֙ וַיַּֽעֲל֨וּ אִתּ֜וֹ זִקְנֵ֣י בֵית֔וֹ וְכֹ֖ל זִקְנֵ֥י אֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ way·ya·‘al liq·bōr ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇîw kāl- ‘aḇ·ḏê p̄ar·‘ōh way·ya·‘ă·lū ’it·tōw ziq·nê ḇê·ṯōw wə·ḵōl ziq·nê ’e·reṣ- miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Then Joseph went to bury - his father and all the servants of Pharaoh accompanied him the elders of Pharaoh’s household and all the elders of the land of Egypt

verses.original: וְכֹל֙ יוֹסֵ֔ף בֵּ֣ית וְאֶחָ֖יו אָבִ֑יו וּבֵ֣ית רַ֗ק טַפָּם֙ וְצֹאנָ֣ם וּבְקָרָ֔ם עָזְב֖וּ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ גֹּֽשֶׁן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl yō·w·sêp̄ bêṯ wə·’e·ḥāw ’ā·ḇîw ū·ḇêṯ raq ṭap·pām wə·ṣō·nām ū·ḇə·qā·rām ‘ā·zə·ḇū bə·’e·reṣ gō·šen
verses.literal: along with all of Joseph’s household and his brothers and his father’s household Only their children and flocks and herds were left vvv in Goshen

verses.original: רֶ֖כֶב גַּם־ פָּרָשִׁ֑ים גַּם־ וַיַּ֣עַל עִמּ֔וֹ וַיְהִ֥י מְאֹֽד׃ כָּבֵ֥ד הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה
verses.transliteration: re·ḵeḇ gam- pā·rā·šîm gam- way·ya·‘al ‘im·mōw way·hî mə·’ōḏ kā·ḇêḏ ham·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: Chariots and horsemen alike went up with him and it was an exceedingly large procession

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ עַד־ גֹּ֣רֶן הָאָטָ֗ד אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וַיִּ֨סְפְּדוּ־ שָׁ֔ם מִסְפֵּ֛ד גָּד֥וֹל וְכָבֵ֖ד מְאֹ֑ד וַיַּ֧עַשׂ אֵ֖בֶל לְאָבִ֛יו שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘aḏ- gō·ren hā·’ā·ṭāḏ ’ă·šer bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên way·yis·pə·ḏū- šām mis·pêḏ gā·ḏō·wl wə·ḵā·ḇêḏ mə·’ōḏ way·ya·‘aś ’ê·ḇel lə·’ā·ḇîw šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: When they reached . . . the threshing floor of Atad which is across the Jordan they lamented . . . and wailed loudly . . . . . . and Joseph mourned . . . for his father seven days

verses.original: הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֜י אֶת־ יוֹשֵׁב֩ הָאָ֨רֶץ וַיַּ֡רְא הָאֵ֗בֶל בְּגֹ֙רֶן֙ הָֽאָטָ֔ד וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ זֶ֖ה כָּבֵ֥ד אֵֽבֶל־ לְמִצְרָ֑יִם עַל־ כֵּ֞ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃ קָרָ֤א שְׁמָהּ֙ אָבֵ֣ל מִצְרַ֔יִם
verses.transliteration: hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî ’eṯ- yō·wō·šêḇ hā·’ā·reṣ way·yar hā·’ê·ḇel bə·ḡō·ren hā·’ā·ṭāḏ way·yō·mə·rū zeh kā·ḇêḏ ’ê·ḇel- lə·miṣ·rā·yim ‘al- kên ’ă·šer bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên qā·rā šə·māh ’ā·ḇêl miṣ·ra·yim
verses.literal: When the Canaanites - vvv of the land saw the mourning . . . at the threshing floor of Atad they said This is a solemn ceremony of mourning by the Egyptians Thus . . . the place across the Jordan is called . . . vvv Abel-mizraim

verses.original: בָנָ֖יו ל֑וֹ כֵּ֖ן וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ḇā·nāw lōw kên way·ya·‘ă·śū ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wām
verses.literal: So Jacob’s sons - did as he had charged them

verses.original: בָנָיו֙ וַיִּשְׂא֨וּ אֹת֤וֹ אַ֣רְצָה כְּנַ֔עַן וַיִּקְבְּר֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ בִּמְעָרַ֖ת הַמַּכְפֵּלָ֑ה שְׂדֵ֣ה עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י מַמְרֵֽא׃ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַבְרָהָ֨ם אֶת־ הַשָּׂדֶ֜ה קָנָה֩ עֶפְרֹ֥ן הַחִתִּ֖י קֶ֗בֶר מֵאֵ֛ת לַאֲחֻזַּת־
verses.transliteration: ḇā·nāw way·yiś·’ū ’ō·ṯōw ’ar·ṣāh kə·na·‘an way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw bim·‘ā·raṯ ham·maḵ·pê·lāh śə·ḏêh ‘al- pə·nê mam·rê ’ă·šer ’aḇ·rā·hām ’eṯ- haś·śā·ḏeh qā·nāh ‘ep̄·rōn ha·ḥit·tî qe·ḇer mê·’êṯ la·’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ-
verses.literal: They carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave at Machpelah in the field near . . . Mamre which Abraham - - had purchased from Ephron the Hittite as a burial . . . site

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֖י קָבְר֥וֹ אֶת־ יוֹסֵ֤ף לִקְבֹּ֣ר אֶת־ אָבִ֑יו וַיָּ֨שָׁב מִצְרַ֙יְמָה֙ ה֣וּא וְאֶחָ֔יו וְכָל־ הָעֹלִ֥ים אִתּ֖וֹ אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rê qā·ḇə·rōw ’eṯ- yō·w·sêp̄ liq·bōr ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇîw way·yā·šāḇ miṣ·ray·māh hū wə·’e·ḥāw wə·ḵāl hā·‘ō·lîm ’it·tōw ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: After . . . - Joseph had buried - his father he returned to Egypt . . . with his brothers and all who had gone with him to bury his father

verses.original: יוֹסֵף֙ אֲחֵֽי־ וַיִּרְא֤וּ כִּי־ אֲבִיהֶ֔ם מֵ֣ת וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ ל֥וּ יוֹסֵ֑ף יִשְׂטְמֵ֖נוּ וְהָשֵׁ֤ב יָשִׁיב֙ לָ֔נוּ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גָּמַ֖לְנוּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ ’ă·ḥê- way·yir·’ū kî- ’ă·ḇî·hem mêṯ way·yō·mə·rū lū yō·w·sêp̄ yiś·ṭə·mê·nū wə·hā·šêḇ yā·šîḇ lā·nū ’êṯ kāl- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer gā·mal·nū ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead they said What if Joseph bears a grudge Then he will surely repay . . . us - for all the evil that we did to him

verses.original: וַיְצַוּ֕וּ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֖ף לֵאמֹ֑ר לִפְנֵ֥י מוֹת֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃ אָבִ֣יךָ צִוָּ֔ה
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw·wū ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ lê·mōr lip̄·nê mō·w·ṯōw lê·mōr ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ṣiw·wāh
verses.literal: So they sent word to Joseph saying Before he died . . . your father commanded

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ תֹאמְר֣וּ לְיוֹסֵ֗ף אָ֣נָּ֡א נָ֠א שָׂ֣א פֶּ֣שַׁע וְחַטָּאתָם֙ אַחֶ֤יךָ כִּי־ גְמָל֔וּךָ רָעָ֣ה וְעַתָּה֙ נָ֔א שָׂ֣א לְפֶ֥שַׁע עַבְדֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵ֣י אָבִ֑יךָ בְּדַבְּרָ֥ם אֵלָֽיו׃ יוֹסֵ֖ף וַיֵּ֥בְךְּ
verses.transliteration: kōh- ṯō·mə·rū lə·yō·w·sêp̄ ’ān·nā nā śā pe·ša‘ wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām ’a·ḥe·ḵā kî- ḡə·mā·lū·ḵā rā·‘āh wə·‘at·tāh nā śā lə·p̄e·ša‘ ‘aḇ·ḏê ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ā·ḇî·ḵā bə·ḏab·bə·rām ’ê·lāw yō·w·sêp̄ way·yê·ḇək
verses.literal: This is what you are to say to Joseph I beg you please forgive the transgression and sin of your brothers for they did you wrong So now, [Joseph] please forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of your father When their message came to him Joseph wept

verses.original: אֶחָ֔יו גַּם־ וַיֵּלְכוּ֙ וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ לְפָנָ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ הִנֶּ֥נּֽוּ לְךָ֖ לַעֲבָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·ḥāw gam- way·yê·lə·ḵū way·yip·pə·lū lə·p̄ā·nāw way·yō·mə·rū hin·nen·nū lə·ḵā la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm
verses.literal: His brothers also came to him bowed down before him and said . . . We are your slaves

verses.original: יוֹסֵ֖ף וַיֹּ֧אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֛ם אַל־ תִּירָ֑אוּ כִּ֛י אָֽנִי׃ הֲתַ֥חַת אֱלֹהִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’al- tî·rā·’ū kî ’ā·nî hă·ṯa·ḥaṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: But Joseph replied . . . Do not be afraid . . . Am I in the place of God

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֕ם חֲשַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָלַ֖י רָעָ֑ה אֱלֹהִים֙ חֲשָׁבָ֣הּ לְטֹבָ֔ה לְמַ֗עַן עֲשֹׂ֛ה כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה לְהַחֲיֹ֥ת רָֽב׃ עַם־
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem ḥă·šaḇ·tem ‘ā·lay rā·‘āh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥă·šā·ḇāh lə·ṭō·ḇāh lə·ma·‘an ‘ă·śōh kay·yō·wm haz·zeh lə·ha·ḥă·yōṯ rāḇ ‘am-
verses.literal: As for you what you intended against me for evil God intended for good in order to accomplish a day like this to preserve the lives of many people

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ אַל־ תִּירָ֔אוּ אָנֹכִ֛י אֲכַלְכֵּ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֖ם וְאֶֽת־ טַפְּכֶ֑ם וַיְנַחֵ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר עַל־ לִבָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’al- tî·rā·’ū ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ă·ḵal·kêl ’eṯ·ḵem wə·’eṯ- ṭap·pə·ḵem way·na·ḥêm ’ō·w·ṯām way·ḏab·bêr ‘al- lib·bām
verses.literal: Therefore do not be afraid I will provide for you - and your little ones So [Joseph] reassured [his brothers] and spoke kindly to them . . .

verses.original: יוֹסֵף֙ אָבִ֑יו וּבֵ֣ית וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם ה֖וּא יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיְחִ֣י שָׁנִֽים׃ מֵאָ֥ה וָעֶ֖שֶׂר
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ ’ā·ḇîw ū·ḇêṯ way·yê·šeḇ bə·miṣ·ra·yim hū yō·w·sêp̄ way·ḥî šā·nîm mê·’āh wā·‘e·śer
verses.literal: Now Joseph and his father’s household remained in Egypt . . . and Joseph lived to the age of 110 . . .

verses.original: יוֹסֵף֙ וַיַּ֤רְא לְאֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּנֵ֖י שִׁלֵּשִׁ֑ים גַּ֗ם בְּנֵ֤י מָכִיר֙ בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה יֻלְּד֖וּ עַל־ יוֹסֵֽף׃ בִּרְכֵּ֥י
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ way·yar lə·’ep̄·ra·yim bə·nê šil·lê·šîm gam bə·nê mā·ḵîr ben- mə·naš·šeh yul·lə·ḏū ‘al- yō·w·sêp̄ bir·kê
verses.literal: He saw Ephraim’s sons to the third generation and indeed the sons of Machir son of Manasseh were brought up on Joseph’s knees

verses.original: יוֹסֵף֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ אֶחָ֔יו אָנֹכִ֖י מֵ֑ת וֵֽאלֹהִ֞ים פָּקֹ֧ד יִפְקֹ֣ד אֶתְכֶ֗ם וְהֶעֱלָ֤ה אֶתְכֶם֙ מִן־ הַזֹּ֔את הָאָ֣רֶץ אֶל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֛ע לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ way·yō·mer ’el- ’e·ḥāw ’ā·nō·ḵî mêṯ wê·lō·hîm pā·qōḏ yip̄·qōḏ ’eṯ·ḵem wə·he·‘ĕ·lāh ’eṯ·ḵem min- haz·zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer niš·ba‘ lə·’aḇ·rā·hām lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: Then Joseph said to his brothers I am about to die but God will surely visit . . . you and bring you up - from this land to the land - He promised on oath to Abraham Isaac and Jacob

verses.original: יוֹסֵ֔ף אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיַּשְׁבַּ֣ע לֵאמֹ֑ר אֱלֹהִים֙ פָּקֹ֨ד יִפְקֹ֤ד אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהַעֲלִתֶ֥ם עַצְמֹתַ֖י אֶת־ מִזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yaš·ba‘ lê·mōr ’ĕ·lō·hîm pā·qōḏ yip̄·qōḏ ’eṯ·ḵem wə·ha·‘ă·li·ṯem ‘aṣ·mō·ṯay ’eṯ- miz·zeh
verses.literal: And Joseph - made the sons of Israel take an oath and said God will surely attend to . . . you and then you must carry my bones up from this place

verses.original: יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיָּ֣מָת בֶּן־ מֵאָ֥ה וָעֶ֖שֶׂר שָׁנִ֑ים וַיַּחַנְט֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ וַיִּ֥ישֶׂם בָּאָר֖וֹן בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ way·yā·māṯ ben- mê·’āh wā·‘e·śer šā·nîm way·ya·ḥan·ṭū ’ō·ṯōw way·yî·śem bā·’ā·rō·wn bə·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: So Joseph died at the age of 110 . . . . . . And they embalmed [his body] and placed it in a coffin in Egypt
